name: PP2 Language Activities Term 1 Exam
subject: Language Activities
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Your teacher will read the questions aloud.

items.question: What is the sound of the letter 'S'?
A baby dog is called a?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (21 marks)
items: 1. Write your name and the name of your school. (3 marks)
2. Write the first five letters of the alphabet. (5 marks)
3. Name the picture: a round yellow fruit that monkeys love. (2 marks)
4. Say the sound of 'm' and write two words starting with 'm'. (3 marks)
5. Sing or say a short rhyme you know. (2 marks)
